description: Change a monitor: its name, targets, schedule, webhook or email, or pause and resume it with status. Only the fields you pass change; targets replace the whole list.

email.description: daily: email the workspace owner a summary of changes once a day.

every.description: How often to check. 1d suits almost everything; a search target checks at most hourly.

monitorId.description: The monitor id from monitor_create or monitor_list.

retentionDays.description: How long to keep the history, in days.

status.description: paused stops the checks; active starts them again.

excludePaths.description: site only: leave out pages whose path matches one of these regexes.

goal.description: What the user is watching for, in plain words, like "a plan gets cheaper". Only matching changes alert; 1 credit per change checked.

ignore.description: pages only: lines to leave out before comparing. Wrap in slashes for a regex.

includePaths.description: site only: only count pages whose path matches one of these regexes.

limit.description: site: most pages to track (default 200). search: top results to look at (default 10).

query.description: search only: what to search for.

readNewPages.description: site only: read each new page for its title and opening lines, 1 credit each.

selector.description: pages only: CSS selectors; only the content inside them is compared.

triggerOn.description: pages only: alert only when a changed line contains one of these.

type.description: pages: watch what the given pages say. site: report pages that appear on or leave a site. search: report results a search has never returned before.

url.description: site only: where the site starts.

urls.description: pages only: the pages to watch, up to 50.

webhook.description: Where to send changes as they happen.

url.description: An https URL to call with each change.

name: monitor_update
title: Update a monitor
